title: Overhead Chat
description: This is a Overhead plugin that show the chat above the head of the player
body:
## OverheadChat

**OverheadChat** is a lightweight Minecraft plugin that displays player chat messages above their head as a floating hologram, making conversations more immersive and realistic.

Each time a player sends a message, it appears above their head along with their player head, creating a modern and roleplay-friendly chat experience.

### Features

- Chat messages appear above the player’s head

- Player head shown above the chat (optional)

- Fully customizable via config.yml

- Configurable duration & floating animation

- Lightweight and performance-friendly

- Easy to install & use

- No dependencies required

- Configuration

**Everything can be customized from the config:**

- Chat text color

- Bold text on/off

- Height (Y-offset) of the chat

- Floating speed

- Message duration

**Enable / disable player head
Example:**

chat-range: 10.0
y-offset: 2.0
duration-ticks: 100
float-speed: 2
text-color: GOLD
bold-text: true
show-head: true

### Compatibility

- Paper / Spigot

- Minecraft 1.16+
